column1: # TITLE: Gene expression profiles of tumor and paired normal lung tissues from primary non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients in Taiwan.

# SUMMARY: Genome-wide expression profiling of NSCLC patients were done using Phalanx Human OneArray chip. The surgically resected tumor tissue and corresponding normal tissue were collected from 21 patients diagnosed with primary NSCLC admitted to Taipei Veterans General Hospital
